en: Color postcard showing an oblique view of central Piatra Neamț, Romania. The foreground features the ornate Teatrul Tineretului (Youth's Theatre). To the left is a modern office block; in the background are historic buildings and a stone tower, with forested hills surrounding the town. The reverse is a Romanian "Carte Poștală" by Editura Sport‑Turism with address fields and a printed price.
